overview: A private, mobile-first stylist rotation workspace that uses staff-confirmed Booksy availability, service eligibility, and a persistent fair order to show who is up next.
features: Show a live general rotation with the stylist who is up next
Check a specific service to produce an explainable primary recommendation and backup
Track services stylists love, perform, and do not perform
Let staff select every stylist Booksy shows as free for the requested time
Preserve a busy stylist's place while moving to the next available person
Balance opportunities through a transparent least-recently-booked rotation
Mark stylists booked and track outcomes, overrides, and an audit history
